card.name: The word cases in adverse event reports
card.fires_on: The word "cases" (or "Cases") that begins or follows a short opener in a warnings or adverse reactions passage, as in "Cases of ... have been reported", "Fatal cases" or "Some cases".

modes.label: Sentence-initial Cases
modes.description: "Cases" opens a new sentence reporting that an event has occurred.
modes.example: << Cases>> of aseptic meningitis have been

modes.label: Cases after a qualifier
modes.description: "cases" follows a qualifier such as Fatal or Some.
modes.example: Fatal<< cases>> of each type of event have occurred.

card.plain: It marks the word "cases" when a label says that reports of a reaction have occurred.
